# Lifecycle & Retention

`lifecycle-and-retention` · v1.0.1 · Design · Retention & Lifecycle
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/lifecycle-and-retention/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How fast is our existing customer base leaking or growing, and which retention move should we fund first?

**Inputs:** One period of revenue movement (starting recurring revenue, new, expansion, contraction, churned), customer counts, and where available the top churn reasons, the activation milestone, and the current onboarding steps

**Output:** NRR, GRR, revenue & logo churn, quick ratio, average lifetime, the LTV impact of a churn change, and a prioritized retention plan across onboarding, churn drivers, and expansion

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill lifecycle-and-retention`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/lifecycle-and-retention/resources/retention.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/lifecycle-and-retention/resources/retention.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It reads one period at a time. A single month is not a trend; read the numbers against your own segment and your own history.
- NRR and GRR are compared with reference points only for annual input. Those points were set for Series B/C enterprise software and bootstrapped $3M-$20M ARR SaaS.
- High NRR can hide heavy logo churn behind a few large expansions. Read GRR and logo churn alongside it; logo churn needs customer counts.
- An unrecognised field, or an amount that isn't a number, stops the run with an error naming it. It can't tell whether the amounts match the period you chose, so confirm monthly or annual.

**Review before acting:** The finance lead confirms the period's movement reconciles to billing, that new business is kept out of expansion, and which period was used, before NRR or GRR goes to the board.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/lifecycle-and-retention](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/lifecycle-and-retention)
